text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a message from Dad! Let's see——
'Just in case, don't forget your raincoat tomorrow'...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see.
You're going to the amusement park together tomorrow, right?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Yup! He said, 'The amusement park is gonna be a blast!'
Dad's super excited too!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: It's been quite a while~! Dad travels overseas for work so often——so, that's why!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow, I'm going to give him the absolute beeeest escort ever so he has tons of fun!!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Dad!
Let's enjoy today to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Though there's quite a massive crowd today.
Don't stray too far, alright? You'll get lost.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I won't get lost~.
I've already checked the map thoroughly, after all!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Umm... First up is over there!
The most popular attraction in this whole park!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
Craft, are you alright?
I'll go ahead. Stay behind me.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! 
I'm totally fine! Ghosts don't scare me at all............

text_block_list.name: Ghost Staff
text_block_list.text: Wahh!!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I should have stopped you.
You cried over a picture book ghost in the past, too...

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: T-That was when I was a kid, okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Even now... well... it's not like I'm GREAT with them... but even I have times when I want to go!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Next is the roller coaster!
My friends told me it's super recommended!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Ugh... that was awful~.

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh no! I'll go buy some drinks right now.
Craft, just sit right here and rest...!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! No, no, I'm fine!
You're exaggerating way too much!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
I mean... Dad...
I've been thinking this for a while now, but——

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: You treat me waaaay too much like a kid!!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
I've grown up since entering Tracen Academy, you know?
Into a horse girl worthy of a tiara!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
I'm sorry, even though I've been watching your successes on TV.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: That's right, so no more treating me like a kid——

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! They were selling tiara hair accessories over there!
Want me to buy one as a souvenir? It sparkles!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: A hair accessory?! GEEZ, COME ONNNNN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading to the library
to pick up some race materials——

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: He just treasures you so, so much, and that's why he worries.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Even so~... Mmh, that settles it! Someday I'm definitely gonna prove to Dad that I'm a grown-up!
